experiment_b.experiment: Experiment B — Held-Out Test Set Accuracy Before vs. After Feedback Loop

learned_principles.principle: [Semiconductor Manufacturing (Fab Telemetry)] With a 3-person ops team on-prem and 50k events/sec (<1s latency), NATS JetStream or Redpanda provides single-binary simplicity without JVM tuning, while Strimzi Kafka is acceptable if Kubernetes is already mature. Raw Kafka+ZK is too heavy, and AWS Kinesis violates on-prem data sovereignty.
learned_principles.preferred_pattern: NATS JetStream (Clustered Go Single-Binary) or Redpanda
learned_principles.rationale: With a 3-person ops team on-prem and 50k events/sec (<1s latency), NATS JetStream or Redpanda provides single-binary simplicity without JVM tuning, while Strimzi Kafka is acceptable if Kubernetes is already mature. Raw Kafka+ZK is too heavy, and AWS Kinesis violates on-prem data sovereignty.

learned_principles.principle: [Semiconductor Yield Analytics] At 80k metrics/sec with heavy relational metadata joins and a 4-person PostgreSQL-skilled team, TimescaleDB satisfies throughput while keeping a single database engine and zero cross-DB sync pipelines.
learned_principles.rationale: At 80k metrics/sec with heavy relational metadata joins and a 4-person PostgreSQL-skilled team, TimescaleDB satisfies throughput while keeping a single database engine and zero cross-DB sync pipelines.

learned_principles.principle: [Enterprise Supply Chain] For a 5-developer team with no SRE and a 4-month deadline, a Modular Monolith avoids distributed systems tax while enforcing module boundaries for future extraction.
learned_principles.preferred_pattern: Modular Monolith with Explicit Domain Boundaries & Single PostgreSQL
learned_principles.rationale: For a 5-developer team with no SRE and a 4-month deadline, a Modular Monolith avoids distributed systems tax while enforcing module boundaries for future extraction.

learned_principles.principle: [Manufacturing Execution System (MES)] For an 8-step workflow with timeouts and compensating rollbacks, an Orchestrated Saga (Temporal/State Machine) prevents cyclic event spaghetti and gives a centralized audit trail.
learned_principles.preferred_pattern: Orchestrated Saga via Durable Workflow Engine (Temporal / State Machine)
learned_principles.rationale: For an 8-step workflow with timeouts and compensating rollbacks, an Orchestrated Saga (Temporal/State Machine) prevents cyclic event spaghetti and gives a centralized audit trail.

learned_principles.principle: [Industrial Edge & Multi-Site Manufacturing] An Edge-First Store-and-Forward Gateway processes local safety alerts in <1s and persists data to local disk during 4-hour WAN outages, syncing asynchronously upon reconnection.
learned_principles.preferred_pattern: Edge-First Store-and-Forward Gateway (Local NATS Leaf / SQLite Buffer)
learned_principles.rationale: An Edge-First Store-and-Forward Gateway processes local safety alerts in <1s and persists data to local disk during 4-hour WAN outages, syncing asynchronously upon reconnection.

learned_principles.principle: [Enterprise Order Processing] Transactional Outbox with a lightweight Polling Publisher guarantees at-least-once consistency using only PostgreSQL, avoiding the operational burden of running a Debezium + Kafka Connect cluster for a 3-person team.
learned_principles.preferred_pattern: Transactional Outbox Table with Lightweight Polling Publisher
learned_principles.rationale: Transactional Outbox with a lightweight Polling Publisher guarantees at-least-once consistency using only PostgreSQL, avoiding the operational burden of running a Debezium + Kafka Connect cluster for a 3-person team.

learned_principles.principle: [Legacy Modernization] Strangler Fig with an Anti-Corruption Layer migrates vertical slices incrementally behind a routing proxy, eliminating Big-Bang cutover risk while isolating the new domain model from legacy schema pollution.
learned_principles.preferred_pattern: Strangler Fig Pattern with Routing Facade & Anti-Corruption Layer (ACL)
learned_principles.rationale: Strangler Fig with an Anti-Corruption Layer migrates vertical slices incrementally behind a routing proxy, eliminating Big-Bang cutover risk while isolating the new domain model from legacy schema pollution.

learned_principles.principle: [Platform Security] For 4 services and 2 developers, OIDC/OAuth2 JWT validation at the ingress gateway plus Kubernetes NetworkPolicies achieves strong security without the upgrade and debugging overhead of a full service mesh.
learned_principles.preferred_pattern: API Gateway with OIDC/OAuth2 JWT Validation + K8s NetworkPolicies
learned_principles.rationale: For 4 services and 2 developers, OIDC/OAuth2 JWT validation at the ingress gateway plus Kubernetes NetworkPolicies achieves strong security without the upgrade and debugging overhead of a full service mesh.

learned_principles.principle: [Compliance & Safety Systems] Event Sourcing with an append-only hash-chained table in PostgreSQL provides immutable auditability and temporal state reconstruction without external blockchain latency or CRUD state-overwrite loss.
learned_principles.preferred_pattern: Event Sourcing with Append-Only Cryptographically Chained Log in PostgreSQL
learned_principles.rationale: Event Sourcing with an append-only hash-chained table in PostgreSQL provides immutable auditability and temporal state reconstruction without external blockchain latency or CRUD state-overwrite loss.

learned_principles.principle: [Logistics Integration] Bulkhead isolation ensures one slow carrier can only saturate its dedicated pool, while a Circuit Breaker trips fast and routes requests to an async retry queue.
learned_principles.preferred_pattern: Bulkhead Thread/Connection Pool Isolation + Circuit Breaker with Fallback Queue
learned_principles.rationale: Bulkhead isolation ensures one slow carrier can only saturate its dedicated pool, while a Circuit Breaker trips fast and routes requests to an async retry queue.

learned_principles.principle: [Enterprise Knowledge & Catalog] For a 99.5% read workload and a 3-person team, PostgreSQL with Read Replicas and Cache-Aside Redis delivers <10ms reads with minimal operational complexity.
learned_principles.preferred_pattern: Primary PostgreSQL + Read Replicas + Cache-Aside Redis
learned_principles.rationale: For a 99.5% read workload and a 3-person team, PostgreSQL with Read Replicas and Cache-Aside Redis delivers <10ms reads with minimal operational complexity.

learned_principles.principle: [Global Enterprise Platform] With 120 engineers across 15 teams and dedicated Platform SREs, Conway's Law and release autonomy justify domain-aligned microservices with contract testing.
learned_principles.preferred_pattern: Domain-Aligned Microservices with API Gateway, Contract Testing & Platform PaaS
learned_principles.rationale: With 120 engineers across 15 teams and dedicated Platform SREs, Conway's Law and release autonomy justify domain-aligned microservices with contract testing.
